meta.title: A surrogate technical response can be entered for a vendor
warnings: the QA memory is not built, so the plan was written without it — run `npm run rag:build`

steps.note: Open the prepared event's Participants screen as required for this live state.
Enter and submit the vendor's surrogate technical response, including the global and line-item forms.
Verify the buyer sees one submitted technical response and that it is marked as a surrogate bid.
